answer: Every claim must carry its draft trail. When work is filed, the Ocean desk reads the spiral of drafts behind it — the saved versions, notes, and timestamps stretching back to the horizon when the job began — and checks the trail shows gradual progress over real hours. A claim pasted in one shot, with no drafts behind it, is rejected and forfeits a 250-coin bond, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 faked histories plus 250,000 coins in bonds. One operator filed forty finished reports in a morning; none had a single draft, and every bond was gone by noon.
